llm_response.reason: pokemonnl.com displays several characteristics of scam sites: (1) the domain was registered extremely recently (2025-06-12) and uses a privacy service in Malaysia while targeting Dutch customers; (2) no verifiable business registration or Dutch Chamber of Commerce number is shown, which is mandatory for Dutch webshops; (3) there are no independent reviews or mentions online; (4) the e-commerce structure and branding mimic legitimate sites, but this is easily replicable by scammers. The overall combination of opaque ownership, absence of customer discussion, and lack of legal compliance strongly indicates a fake online shopping scam.
